assumptions_or_scope: Applies to the CLDN18.2 gastric/GEJ cancer demo fixture and nearby solid-tumor cell therapy target-validation workflows.
interpretation: This is the prototype output contract that Gate 4 should translate into acceptance criteria. It is a planning artifact, not a protocol.
object_text: TargetBench validation packet schema: target rationale; expression and off-tumor screen; model-system suggestions; assay modules; controls; readouts; safety gaps; go/no-go gates; citations and gap labels.
